name: quick-commerce-app
description: Quick commerce storefront, admin panel, and versioned REST API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @qc/api" "npm run dev -w @qc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run build -w @qc/api && npm run build -w @qc/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run db:generate -w @qc/api && eslint .
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run db:generate -w @qc/api && eslint . --fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run db:generate -w @qc/api && npm run typecheck -w @qc/api && npm run typecheck -w @qc/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run test -w @qc/shared && npm run test -w @qc/api && npm run test -w @qc/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @qc/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @qc/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @qc/api && npm run test:coverage -w @qc/web
